// INTELLIGENT WORKOUT SELECTION
// Uses week number for variety rotation + randomization for freshness
function selectWeeklyWorkouts() {
  const today = new Date();
  const weekNum = Math.floor((today - new Date(today.getFullYear(), 0, 1)) / (7 * 24 * 60 * 60 * 1000));
  const selectedWorkouts = [];
  const usedNames = new Set();
  
  // Helper to pick random workout avoiding duplicates
  function pickRandom(arr) {
    const available = arr.filter(w => !usedNames.has(w.name));
    if (available.length === 0) return arr[Math.floor(Math.random() * arr.length)];
    const picked = available[Math.floor(Math.random() * available.length)];
    usedNames.add(picked.name);
    return picked;
  }
  
  // Rotate quality focus each week: VO2 → Threshold → Tempo → Mixed
  const qualityRotation = ['vo2max', 'threshold', 'tempo', 'vo2max'];
  const primaryQuality = qualityRotation[weekNum % 4];
  const secondaryQualities = ['vo2max', 'threshold', 'tempo'].filter(q => q !== primaryQuality);
  const secondaryQuality = secondaryQualities[weekNum % 2];
  
  // 1. EASY/RECOVERY - Always include one
  selectedWorkouts.push(pickRandom(workouts.easy));
  
  // 2. PRIMARY QUALITY SESSION - Based on weekly rotation
  selectedWorkouts.push(pickRandom(workouts[primaryQuality]));
  
  // 3. LONG RUN - Always include, rotate types
  selectedWorkouts.push(pickRandom(workouts.longRun));
  
  // 4. SECONDARY QUALITY or SPEED - Alternate weeks
  if (weekNum % 2 === 0) {
    selectedWorkouts.push(pickRandom(workouts[secondaryQuality]));
  } else {
    selectedWorkouts.push(pickRandom(workouts.speed));
  }
  
  // 5. MARATHON or SPECIALTY - Based on training phase feel
  const phaseOptions = weekNum % 3 === 0 ? workouts.marathon : workouts.specialty;
  selectedWorkouts.push(pickRandom(phaseOptions));
  
  // 6. BONUS - Beginner option or extra variety
  if (weekNum % 4 === 0) {
    selectedWorkouts.push(pickRandom(workouts.beginner));
  } else {
    // Pick from a random underrepresented category
    const bonusCategories = ['tempo', 'threshold', 'speed', 'specialty'];
    const bonusCat = bonusCategories[Math.floor(Math.random() * bonusCategories.length)];
    selectedWorkouts.push(pickRandom(workouts[bonusCat]));
  }
  
  return selectedWorkouts;
}

// Format workout for Telegram
function formatWorkout(workout, index) {
  const breakdownText = workout.breakdown.map(line => `  • ${line}`).join('\n');
  
  return `
*${index}. ${workout.name}*
🏷️ _${workout.type}_

📝 *Description:*
${workout.description}

📊 *Breakdown:*
${breakdownText}

🔧 *TrainingPeaks Build:*
\`${workout.trainingPeaks}\`
`;
}

const weeklyWorkouts = selectWeeklyWorkouts();
const today = new Date();
